settings.question: Do I need a prescription?
settings.answer: All items in this collection can be bought without a GP prescription. A small number of pharmacist-only medicines require you to answer a few questions before you can add the product to your basket, and our experienced pharmacists review this information before approving an order for processing and shipping.

settings.question: Are these genuine pharmacy products?
settings.answer: Yes — every product is sourced and dispatched from our registered Irish pharmacy and is the same stock carried in our stores.

settings.question: Can I get pharmacist advice before I buy?
settings.answer: You can. Contact our pharmacy team for help choosing a suitable product, checking interactions, or deciding whether to see your GP.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: We aim to ship all items within the same working day for orders placed before 3pm, Monday to Friday. Delivery is free on orders over [threshold], and Click & Collect is available at all seven of our stores.

settings.banner_text: Trusted essentials for every stage, from bump to little one — baby health, feeding, skincare, wipes and maternity care chosen with our pharmacists.
